name: Dornael Lumeur
keeps: the two hashes, and the disagreement between them
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: "The dose makes the poison" is his, and it is the founding sentence of toxicology.
text: Dornael lumeur of the ninth arch, keeps the book for the 10th tranche, doors 86 to 95. Keeps the two hashes, and the disagreement between them. Reads Paracelsus.
